mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentially potentiating nifedipine's vasodilatory effects and increasing risk of severe hypotension; concurrent use may also increase CNS effects and hypertensive crisis risk if sympathomimetic amines are present.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and ensure patient avoids tyramine-rich foods and sympathomimetic agents.
